messages:
sara-support: FYI - customer reports a sudden p95/p99 latency spike (~3s -> 12s) for generation API across a tenant. They started seeing errors around 12:10 UTC. Attaching short repro and logs. Can oncall triage?

sara-support: repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-medium-v1\",\"prompt\":\"summarize:...\"}' (normal traffic volume, not large batch).

sara-support: snippet from customer request-id header: `x-rw-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`

sara-support: logs they pasted:```
[12:12:05UTC] admit_queue: enqueue_time_ms=312, wait_ms=580, state=queued
[12:12:05UTC] worker-pool-34: start_inflight=256, max_inflight=256, admission_drop=18
[12:12:05UTC] kv-cache-hit=false, tokens_generated=0, err=timeout:kv_fetch
[12:12:08UTC] request(req_0a1b2c3d) -> upstream timeout after 10s
```

mike-oncall: looking. Any anomalies in routing or recent deploys? pinging eng-runtime + eng-sre.

mike-oncall: ingress-bot, can you show current admit_queue depth and active worker groups for region `us-west-2`?

ingress-bot: current snapshot for us-west-2: admit_depth=1,842, avg_wait_ms=412, active_workers=128, max_workers=128, fail_open=false, admission_drops_5m=142

lina-eng-runtime: thanks. It looks like worker pool saturated (active == max). Could be a small burst + large seq-length requests. Any pattern for seq length?

sara-support: customer says avg prompt length same as before, but they did a lot of rapid single-shot calls right after a marketing email.

raj-eng-sre: initial mitigation ideas: 1) enable fast-fail for high-latency tails (`enable_fast_fail=true`) for the affected route; 2) temporarily route heavy tenants to fallback smaller model `rwd-small-v1` via policy; 3) bump worker pool by +32 if capacity available. Which do we want first?

mike-oncall: I can toggle fast-fail now and flip routing to fallback model for that tenant. Lina/raj, can you check whether capacity autoscaler will spin up extra workers or if we're at infra limit?

lina-eng-runtime: autoscaler reported no infra headroom in us-west-2 (quota reached). Bumping pool won't spin up new instances. Suggest: fast-fail + model fallback + increased prefix caching for that tenant.

mike-oncall: actioning: toggling feature flag for route `route:r-3412` -> `enable_fast_fail=true`. Also adding fallback rule: if admit_queue_wait_ms > 250ms, route tenant `acct-9921` -> `rwd-small-v1`.

mike-oncall: CLI I used: `rwctl routes update r-3412 --set enable_fast_fail=true` and `rwctl routing add-fallback --tenant acct-9921 --when "admit_wait_ms>250" --model rwd-small-v1`

ingress-bot: route r-3412 flag updated. fallback rule inserted.

raj-eng-sre: monitoring: admit_drops dropping from 18->2 in last 40s, avg_wait_ms down 412->180, p95 latency trending down. Good. Still watching for retries backpressure.

sara-support: customer confirmed partial improvement, some calls now at ~1.4s p95. They still see a few timeouts for long prompts.

lina-eng-runtime: to reduce residual tail, also enabling aggressive KV prefetch for that tenant and lowering max_concurrency to 6 for their route to reduce head-of-line blocking. I'll apply now.

lina-eng-runtime: applied `max_concurrency=6` and `kv_prefetch=aggressive` on r-3412 for acct-9921.

mike-oncall: logged incident INC-2026 for tracking and notified customer success. Please add postmortem notes if we see recurrence.

raj-eng-sre: follow-ups: 1) add a rate-based admission rule to smooth marketing bursts (token-bucket per-tenant), 2) add telemetry to surface seq_length spikes before capacity saturation, 3) evaluate whether we should reserve burst capacity for enterprise tenants.

sara-support: thanks team. I'll update the customer with the mitigation steps and INC ref. Closing thread here but will reopen if they see regressions. :thumbsup:
